title: Preparation of Human Red Blood Cells for Scanning Electron Microscopy Imaging
author: Marie Anne Balanant
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yvhfw36
materials: Cover with a layer of gold palladium

steps.title: Prepare glass coverslips
steps.instruction: Coat glass coverslips with poly-D-lysine to prepare them for cell attachment.

substeps.instruction: Incubate coverslips in 10% volume poly-D-lysine solution in PBS for 30 minutes at room temperature (RT).
Rinse twice with milliQ water.
Dry and store at 4 °C until use.
Wash 100 µL of RBC in 900 µL PBS (centrifuge for 2 minutes at 1000g).

steps.title: Resuspend RBCs
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed RBCs in PBS.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend 25 µL of the RBC suspension in 475 µL of PBS.

steps.title: Fix cells with glutaraldehyde
steps.instruction: Fix the cell suspension using glutaraldehyde under a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Slowly add 500 µL of 2% volume glutaraldehyde solution in PBS drop by drop to the cell suspension to reach a final concentration of 1%.
Incubate for 30 minutes in the dark.

steps.title: Wash fixed cells
steps.instruction: Remove glutaraldehyde by washing with PBS.

substeps.instruction: Wash with 1 mL of PBS (centrifuge for 2 minutes at 1000g).

steps.title: Dilute fixed cells
steps.instruction: Dilute the fixed cell suspension in PBS.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 100 µL of fixed cells suspension into 400 µL PBS.

steps.title: Seed cells onto coverslips
steps.instruction: Incubate the diluted cells on the prepared coverslips in 6-well plates.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 200 µL of diluted cell suspension on a poly-D-lysine coated coverslip for 1 hour in corresponding buffer.

steps.title: Rinse and buffer exchange
steps.instruction: Rinse the slides and treat with cacodylate buffer under a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Rinse slide 2 times with PBS, ensuring the cell layer is not scratched or damaged.
Incubate in 0.1 M cacodylate buffer for 10 minutes; repeat this step 3 times.
Incubate with 1 mass percent osmium tetroxide for 1 hour.

steps.title: Rinse samples
steps.instruction: Rinse the post-fixed samples with milliQ water.

substeps.instruction: Rinse twice with milliQ water for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Dehydrate samples
steps.instruction: Gradually dehydrate the sample using an ethanol series.

substeps.instruction: Incubate in 40% volume ethanol for 10 minutes.
Incubate in 50% volume ethanol for 10 minutes.
Incubate in 60% volume ethanol for 10 minutes.
Incubate in 70% volume ethanol for 10 minutes.
Incubate in 80% volume ethanol for 10 minutes.
Incubate in 90% volume ethanol for 10 minutes.
Incubate in 100% volume ethanol for 15 minutes.
Incubate in 100% volume ethanol for 15 minutes.
Incubate in HDMS for 30 minutes; repeat this step twice.

steps.title: Dry samples
steps.instruction: Dry the coverslips under a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Dry under the hood for a minimum of 30 minutes, placing filter paper under the coverslip to prevent it from attaching to the culture plate.
